up:
Production transparent PIXEL ART VFX sprite atlas, EXACTLY 5 rows x 4 columns = 20 separate complete pictures, wide clear gutters. Entire atlas is energy only. New fantasy RPG AXE hits viewed from above: WHITE ivory, pale silver, charcoal-outline pixel clusters. No reference shapes. No character, weapons, glow, scenery, captions, labels, grid, colors, gold or motion-blurred background. Sharp actual pixel edges.

Important camera geometry: all effects are HORIZONTAL ground-perspective shapes, WIDTH at least TWICE HEIGHT. NEVER a tall side-facing crescent or vertical standing C. Think flattened white shockwaves lying in the floor plane, viewed by an overhead camera. All effects intact, fit cells and don't touch neighbors.

Row1 four successive frames of a wide low forward DIAGONAL chopping fan: short emerging curved edge, broad white flash expanding toward SCREEN UP, broken trailing slash, few fading chips.
Row2 four frames of opposite-direction RETURN fan, similarly wide and low, energy sweep follows the axe returning across the upper forward lane.
Row3 four frames of head-first PUSH: squat wide blunt triangular white shock flare pointing SCREEN UP, expanding fan impact, short horizontal ripples, fading fragments. Not a laser or arrow.
Row4 four frames of SMASH at ground: a WHITE flat oval burst with two side spikes and a SMALL central cleave notch. A squat energetic slam mark lying flat on the floor, limited low height. Fracture and white dust wedges expand outward in floor perspective, then fade. No vertical geyser/sword/crescent.
Row5 four frames of SPIN: a low broad elliptical white ribbon with empty middle. A bright leading blade sweep circles clockwise in quarter turns; restrained broken tail, final scattered small chips. Character needs a clear hollow center, not an opaque disk.
Four frames are chronological small beginning, strongest readable flash, breaking trail, residue. Consistent center in each row. Avoid thin geometric vector rings, use organic painted pixel clusters. Fully transparent alpha outside energy.
